meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 看懂工具里的每条提示,弄清它到底能做什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果看到工具里的提示却不知道它具体指什么。
copy.tagline_en: Understand what each in-tool tip actually does before you rely on it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spot a tip while using the tool and want to know what it really does.

howto.what: 解释 senpi 各类提示(启动提示、工作中的提示、Tip: 行)背后实际的代码机制,引用它读过的文件路径,并用你提问的语言回答;还会说明你个人能看到哪些提示。
howto.when: 当你问某条提示是什么意思、某个被提示的功能怎么运作,或你能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 行是什么意思?
say.note: 深挖机制,引用源码路径

say.text: 我现在能看到哪些 senpi 提示?
say.note: 先查提示列表和你的设置

say.text: 这个提示指向的功能是怎么实现的?

howto.what_en: Explains the real code mechanism behind any senpi tip (startup tips, working tips, Tip: lines) in your own language, citing the files it read, and tells you which tips you personally can see.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What was that Tip: line about?
say_en.note: Digs into the mechanism, cites source paths

say_en.text: Which senpi tips can I see?
say_en.note: Checks the tip list and your settings first

say_en.text: How is the feature this tip mentions implemented?
say_en.note: Reads code to verify before explaining
